<script id="egeser-lead-security-v101">
(function(){
  'use strict';

  function init(form){
    if (!form || form.getAttribute('data-egeser-security-v101') === '1') return;
    form.setAttribute('data-egeser-security-v101','1');

    var tokenInput = form.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]');
    var submitButton = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    var status = form.querySelector('.eg-form-status');
    if (!tokenInput) return;

    function busy(state){
      if (submitButton) {
        submitButton.disabled = !!state;
        submitButton.setAttribute('aria-busy', state ? 'true' : 'false');
      }
    }

    function fetchNonce(){
      busy(true);
      return fetch('index.php?route=extension/module/egeser_lead_security/nonce', {
        method:'GET',
        credentials:'same-origin',
        cache:'no-store',
        headers:{
          'X-Requested-With':'XMLHttpRequest',
          'Accept':'application/json'
        }
      })
      .then(function(r){
        return r.json().then(function(data){
          if (!r.ok || !data || !data.success || !data.csrf_token) throw new Error('nonce');
          return data.csrf_token;
        });
      })
      .then(function(token){
        tokenInput.value = token;
        form.setAttribute('data-egeser-nonce-ready','1');
        if (status && (
          status.textContent.indexOf('Oturum doğrulaması') !== -1 ||
          status.textContent.indexOf('güvenlik doğrulaması') !== -1 ||
          status.textContent.indexOf('güvenlik anahtarı') !== -1
        )) {
          status.className='eg-form-status';
          status.textContent='';
        }
        return token;
      })
      .catch(function(){
        tokenInput.value='';
        form.setAttribute('data-egeser-nonce-ready','0');
        if (status) {
          status.className='eg-form-status is-error';
          status.textContent='Form güvenlik anahtarı hazırlanamadı. Sayfayı yenileyip tekrar deneyin.';
        }
        return '';
      })
      .then(function(token){
        busy(false);
        return token;
      });
    }

    fetchNonce();

    form.addEventListener('submit', function(event){
      if (!tokenInput.value || form.getAttribute('data-egeser-nonce-ready') !== '1') {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        fetchNonce().then(function(token){
          if (!token) return;
          if (typeof form.requestSubmit === 'function') {
            form.requestSubmit(submitButton || undefined);
          } else if (submitButton) {
            submitButton.click();
          }
        });
      }
    }, true);
  }

  var forms = document.querySelectorAll('.js-egeser-lead-form');
  for (var i=0; i<forms.length; i++) init(forms[i]);
})();
</script>
